intent.purpose: A small team borrows and returns shared equipment (cameras, laptops, audio, lights).
intent.audience: A member of Example Team who needs a camera or a laptop for a day or a week
intent.tone: Brief and practical, like a note on the cupboard door
intent.successCriteria: A member finds a free piece of kit, borrows it with a return date, and marks it returned; anyone sees who has what

theme.direction: Calm utility: cool grey ground, ink-blue type, a teal accent, rounded but compact controls; a slate dark variant

messages.ui.form.type: This does not look right. Check it and try again.
messages.gate.title: Example Team kit
messages.gate.body: Sign in with your team account to borrow and return the shared equipment.
messages.gate.noProvider: Signing in is not set up yet. Ask the office manager.
messages.session.unreachable: We could not reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.
messages.session.unexpected: Something went wrong while signing in. Try again.
messages.session.failed: Signing in did not work. Try again.
messages.session.refused: That e-mail and password do not match a team account.
messages.auth.error.generic: Signing in did not work. Try again.
messages.auth.error.unknown: Signing in did not work ({code}). Try again.
messages.auth.error.expired: That sign-in took too long. Start again.
messages.notFound.title: Not found
messages.notFound.body: There is no page at this address.
